doc.title: Work — Noa Tournoy
doc.desc: Six works by Noa Tournoy: Éclosion, DataSentinel, SupKonQuest, Gamedex, laying_grass and Ludoria. Context, role, technical decisions and measured results.
lede: Six pieces, from shader to dashboard. Each one says what it is, exactly what I did on it, and what was measured when there was something to measure.
w1: A 3D web experience where scrolling is time. Eight acts, fully procedural, with no models, no textures and no audio files. Solo, end to end. Next.js 15 · React 19 · TypeScript · Three.js · GLSL · WebAudio.
w2: A dashboard for monitoring the security of digital products, at ADEO. Three-month internship. Looker · LookML · Python · React · BigQuery · Terraform · Kubernetes.
w3: Multiplayer real-time strategy. Godot client, authoritative C++20 server on a Raspberry Pi 5, binary TCP protocol, procedural maps. Private repositories.
w4: A video game catalogue built on the RAWG API: search, filters, persistent favourites. TypeScript · React.
w5: A tile-laying game in the console, without a single external dependency. C++17.
w6: Three networked board games: Katerenga, Congress, Isolation. Team of three: interface, art direction and computer opponents. Python · Pygame · sockets.
reste.p: Games in C, PHP applications, rendering exercises, coursework: everything without its own plate here stays public and readable at github.com/Noa-trny.
